name: Wishora
tagline: Personalized songs from a name + memories you share — free 30s preview, then $39 for the full MP3
description: Wishora creates a personalized gift song from a recipient’s name, a shared memory, and an inside joke. Hear a free 30-second preview first, then unlock the full track and downloadable MP3 for a one-time $39. Built for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, proposals, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, graduation, thank-you, in-memory, and just-because moments — a thoughtful AI music gift that sounds like them.
